quote: It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate a vehicle of any kind or character at: In any event, a rate of speed greater than 80 miles per hour.

obligation.description: It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate a vehicle of any kind or character at: In any event, a rate of speed greater than 80 miles per hour.

description.requirement: 'in any event' — the cap binds at every instant regardless of any posted limit
